Dainik Prothom Alor onusondhani timer jonno Union Parishad e 509 bhua birth-death registration record er scheme niye ekta gobhir protibedon likhchi. Investigators 5 ta union examine kore 4 tai forgery confirmed peyechhen, 258 ta birth ebong 251 ta death registration bhua jegulo target pressure er jonno banano hoyechhe. Dainik Jugantorer jonno post-August-2024 Chhatradal o Jubodal er extortion-driven public violence pattern niye ekta ground report likhchi. July 2025 e Chokbazarer sthaniyo byabosayi Chan Miyake chanda na dewar obhijoge dindupure Jubodal-Chhatradal pitiye hottya koreche, October 2025 e Noakhali sadar upojelay mosjid event e shibir-Jubodal clash e 30 jon ahato. Dainik Bangladesh protidiner jonno ekta onushondhani protibedon likhte chai BRTA er driving license fraud niye.
